paragraphs: Avdimi of Chafya (Bava Batra 12a: Haifa), and Rabbi Yitzchak Nappacha. Rabbi Pinchas, Rabbi Simon, Rabbi Abba bar Zamina trace it to Rabbi Avdimi of Haifa’s name; Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Tefillat Hashachar, mishnah 1. Ta'anit, chapter 4: Ivi of Haifa, in Rabbi’s name (see there; perhaps they are one). G.A.Y. writes: Haifi stands beside the Great Sea; there is the synagogue, and Rabbi Avdimi of Haifi is buried there in stone, and Rabbi Yitzchak Nappacha’s grave is in stone (see there). On the mountain’s slope is a beautiful large cave of Elijah. Rabbi Abbahu (see there) said in the name of Rabbi Avdimi (Dimi) of Haifa, Kiddushin 33b. Rabbi Assi in his name; Rabbi Berekhiah in his name, Midrash, beginning of Eikhah. Rabbi Ze'ira in his name, Terumot, chapter 3, halakhah 5; Rabbi Chizkiyah in his name; Rabbi Chelbo and Rabbi Chelbo of Tiva in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 4, mishnah 4; and Rabbi Chanina son of Rabbi Abbahu; Rabbi Yosa in his name. Rabbi Yitzchak bar Nachman, and in his name (see there), Niddah, chapter 2, halakhah 6. In Rabbi Levi’s name. Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani in Avdimi of Chafim’s name, Midrash Kohelet, on “And the dust returns to the earth.” In Resh Lakish’s name, Kilayim, chapter 4, halakhah 4; Shevi'it, chapter 2, halakhah 8.
